verses.text: “Una go observe to do all di commandment wey I command you today, so that una go live, and multiply, and go in and possess di land wey di Lord swear to una papa dem.
You go remember all di way wey di Lord your God don lead you dis 40 years for di wilderness, to humble you, to test you, to know wetin dey your heart, whether you go keep im commandments or no.

E humble you, and allow you to hunger, and feed you with manna, wey you no know, neither una papa dem know, so that e go make you know say man no dey live by bread only, but man dey live by every word wey proceed out of di mouth of di Lord.
Your clothing no wear out on you, neither your foot swell, dis 40 years.
You go consider for your heart say as one man discipline im pikin, so di Lord your God discipline you.
You go keep di commandments of di Lord your God, to waka for im ways, and to fear am.
Because di Lord your God dey bring you into one good land, one land of brooks of water, of springs, and of underground water, wey flow out of valleys and hills,
one land of wheat and barley, of vines and fig trees and pomegranates, one land of olive trees and honey,
one land wia you go eat bread without scarcity, you no go lack anything inside am, one land wey im stones na iron, and out of im hills you go dig copper.
You go eat and dey full, and bless di Lord your God for di good land wey e don give you.
Beware say you no forget di Lord your God, by not keeping im commandments, and im ordinances, and im statutes, wey I command you today,
otherwise when you don eat and dey full, and don build goodly houses, and live inside dem,
and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold dey multiplied, and all wey you get dey multiplied,
your heart go dey lifted up, and you go forget di Lord your God, wey bring you out of di land of Egypt, out of di house of bondage,
wey lead you through dat great and terrible wilderness, wia fiery serpents and scorpions dey, and thirsty ground wey no get water. E bring you water out of di rock of flint.
E feed you for di wilderness with manna, wey una papa dem no know, so that e go humble you, and so that e go test you, to do you good at your latter end,
and you say for your heart, ‘My power and di might of my hand don get me dis wealth.’
But you go remember di Lord your God, because na im dey give you power to get wealth, so that e go establish im covenant wey e swear to your papa dem, as e dey today.
E go be say if you forget di Lord your God at all, and waka after other gods, and serve dem, and worship dem, I testify against una today say una go surely perish.
As di nations wey di Lord make to perish before una, so una go perish, because una no listen to di voice of di Lord una God.”
“Hear, Israel: you dey to pass over di Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier pass yourself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,
one people great and tall, di descendants of di Anakim, wey you know, and wey you don hear say, ‘Who fit stand before di descendants of Anak?’

Know therefore today say di Lord your God na im dey go over before you as one devouring fire. E go destroy dem, and e go bring dem down before you. So you go drive dem out, and make dem perish quickly, as di Lord don speak to you.

No speak for your heart, after di Lord your God don thrust dem out from before you, talk, ‘For my righteousness di Lord don bring me in to possess dis land,’ whereas for di wickedness of dem nations di Lord dey drive dem out from before you.

Not for your righteousness, or for di uprightness of your heart, you dey go in to possess dem land, but for di wickedness of dem nations di Lord your God dey drive dem out from before you, and so that e go establish di word wey di Lord swear to your papa dem, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
Know therefore say di Lord your God no dey give you dis good land to possess am for your righteousness, because you na one stiff necked people.
Remember, and no forget, how you provoke di Lord your God to wrath for di wilderness. From di day wey you leave di land of Egypt, until una come to dis place, una don dey rebellious against di Lord.
Even for Horeb una provoke di Lord to wrath, and di Lord dey angry with una to destroy una.
When I go up into di mountain to receive di tablets of stone, even di tablets of di covenant wey di Lord make with una, I stay for di mountain 40 days and 40 nights. I no eat bread nor drink water.
Di Lord deliver to me di two tablets of stone written with God finger. On dem na all di words wey di Lord speak with una for di mountain out of di middle of di fire for di day of di assembly.
E come be say at di end of 40 days and 40 nights, di Lord give me di two tablets of stone, even di tablets of di covenant.

Di Lord talk to me, ‘Arise, get down quickly from here, because your people wey you bring out of Egypt don corrupt demself. Dem don turn aside quickly out of di way wey I command dem. Dem don make for demself one molten image.’
Moreover di Lord speak to me, talk, ‘I don see dis people, and look, dem na one stiff necked people.
Leave me alone, so that I go destroy dem, and blot out dem name from under heaven, and I go make of you one nation mightier and greater pass dem.’
So I turn and come down from di mountain, and di mountain dey burn with fire. Di two tablets of di covenant dey for my two hands.
I look, and look, una don sin against di Lord una God. Una don make for yourselves one molten calf. Una don turn aside quickly out of di way wey di Lord command una.
I take hold of di two tablets, and throw dem out of my two hands, and break dem before una eyes.

I fall down before di Lord, as at di first, 40 days and 40 nights. I no eat bread nor drink water, because of all una sin wey una sin, in doing wetin dey evil for di sight of di Lord, to provoke am to anger.
Because I dey afraid of di anger and hot displeasure, wey di Lord dey angry against una to destroy una. But di Lord listen to me dat time too.
Di Lord dey very angry with Aaron to destroy am. I pray for Aaron too for di same time.
I take your sin, di calf wey una make, and burn am with fire, and crush am, grinding am very small, until e dey small as dust. I throw di dust of am into di brook wey go down out of di mountain.
For Taberah, and for Massah, and for Kibroth Hattaavah, una provoke di Lord to wrath.
When di Lord send una from Kadesh Barnea, talk, ‘Go up and possess di land wey I don give una,’ una rebel against di commandment of di Lord una God, and una no believe am, nor listen to im voice.
Una don dey rebellious against di Lord from di day wey I know una.
So I fall down before di Lord di 40 days and 40 nights wey I fall down, because di Lord talk say e go destroy una.
I pray to di Lord, and talk, ‘Lord God, no destroy your people and your inheritance, wey you don redeem through your greatness, wey you don bring out of Egypt with one mighty hand.
Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. No look at di stubbornness of dis people, nor at dem wickedness, nor at dem sin,

otherwise di land from wey you bring us out go talk say because di Lord no dey able to bring dem into di land wey e promise dem, and say because e hate dem, e don bring dem out to kill dem for di wilderness.
Yet dem na your people and your inheritance, wey you bring out by your mighty power and by your outstretched arm.’”
“For dat time di Lord talk to me, ‘Cut two tablets of stone like di first, and come up to me on di mountain, and make one ark of wood.
I go write on di tablets di words wey dey di first tablets wey you break, and you go put dem for di ark.’
So I make one ark of acacia wood, and cut two tablets of stone like di first, and go up on di mountain, having di two tablets for my hand.
E write on di tablets, according to di first writing, di Ten Commandments, wey di Lord speak to una for di mountain out of di middle of di fire for di day of di assembly. Di Lord give dem to me.
I turn and come down from di mountain, and put di tablets for di ark wey I make. Dem dey dere, as di Lord command me.
Di pikin dem of Israel journey from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. Aaron die dere, and dem bury am dere. Eleazar im pikin serve as priest for im place.
From dere dem journey to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, one land of brooks of water.
For dat time di Lord set apart di tribe of Levi, to carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord, to stand before di Lord to minister to am, and to bless for im name, to dis day.
Na why Levi no get portion nor inheritance with im brothers. Di Lord na im inheritance, according to wetin di Lord your God talk to am.
I stay for di mountain, as for di first time, 40 days and 40 nights. Di Lord listen to me dat time too. Di Lord no want to destroy you.
Di Lord talk to me, ‘Arise, take your journey before di people, so that dem go go in and possess di land, wey I swear to dem papa dem to give to dem.’

Now, Israel, wetin di Lord your God dey require of you, but to fear di Lord your God, to waka for all im ways, and to love am, and to serve di Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
to keep di commandments of di Lord, and im statutes, wey I command you today for your good?
Look, heaven and di heaven of heavens na di Lord your God own, di earth, with all wey dey inside am.
Only di Lord set im love on your papa dem, to love dem, and e choose dem seed after dem, even you above all peoples, as e dey today.
Circumcise therefore di foreskin of your heart, and no dey stiff necked again.
Because di Lord your God na God of gods, and Lord of lords, di great God, di mighty, and di awesome, wey no show partiality, nor take bribe.
E execute justice for di orphan and di widow, and love di stranger, in giving am food and clothing.
Love therefore di stranger, because una dey strangers for di land of Egypt.
You go fear di Lord your God. Na am you go serve. To am you go hold fast, and by im name you go swear.
Na am be your praise, and na am be your God, wey don do for you dem great and awesome things, wey your eyes don see.
Your papa dem go down into Egypt with 70 persons. Now di Lord your God don make you as di stars of di sky for multitude.”
“Therefore you go love di Lord your God, and keep im charge, and im statutes, and im ordinances, and im commandments, always.
Know today, because I no dey speak with your pikin dem wey no know, and wey no see di discipline of di Lord your God, im greatness, im mighty hand, and im stretched out arm,
im signs, and im works, wey e do for di middle of Egypt to Pharaoh di king of Egypt, and to all im land,
and wetin e do to di army of Egypt, to dem horses, and to dem chariots, how e make di water of di Red Sea overflow dem as dem pursue after una, and how di Lord don destroy dem to dis day,
and wetin e do for una for di wilderness, until una come to dis place,

and wetin e do to Dathan and Abiram, di pikin man dem of Eliab, di pikin of Reuben, how di earth open im mouth, and swallow dem up, and dem households, and dem tents, and every living thing wey dey dem possession, among all Israel.
But your eyes don see all di great work of di Lord wey e do.
Therefore una go keep all di commandment wey I command you today, so that una go dey strong, and go in and possess di land wey una dey go over to possess,
and so that una go prolong una days for di land wey di Lord swear to una papa dem to give to dem and to dem seed, one land wey dey flow with milk and honey.
Because di land, wia you go in to possess am, no be like di land of Egypt, from wey una come out, wia you sow your seed, and water am with your foot, as one garden of herbs.
But di land, wia una go over to possess am, na one land of hills and valleys, and e drink water from di rain of heaven,
one land wey di Lord your God dey care for. Di eyes of di Lord your God dey always upon am, from di beginning of di year even to di end of di year.
E go come be say, if una go listen diligently to my commandments wey I command una today, to love di Lord una God, and to serve am with all una heart and with all una soul,
I go give di rain of una land for im season, di early rain and di later rain, so that you go gather in your grain, and your new wine, and your oil.
I go give grass for your field for your livestock, and you go eat and dey full.
Take heed to yourselves, so that una heart no go dey deceived, and una turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship dem,
and di anger of di Lord dey kindled against una, and e shut up di sky, so that dere no go be rain, and di land no go yield im fruit, and una perish quickly from off di good land wey di Lord give una.
Therefore una go lay up dem my words for una heart and for una soul. Una go bind dem for one sign on una hand, and dem go be as frontlets between una eyes.
Una go teach dem to una pikin dem, talking of dem, when you sit for your house, and when you waka by di way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
You go write dem on di door posts of your house, and on your gates,
so that una days go dey multiplied, and di days of una pikin dem, for di land wey di Lord swear to una papa dem to give dem, as di days of di heavens above di earth.
Because if una go diligently keep all dis commandment wey I command una, to do am, to love di Lord una God, to waka for all im ways, and to hold fast to am,
di Lord go drive out all dem nations from before una, and una go dispossess nations greater and mightier pass yourselves.
Every place wey di sole of una foot go tread upon go be una own. From di wilderness, and Lebanon, from di river, di river Euphrates, even to di western sea, go be una border.
No man go dey able to stand before una. Di Lord una God go lay di fear of una and di dread of una on all di land wey una go tread upon, as e don speak to una.
Look, I set before una today one blessing and one curse:
di blessing, if una listen to di commandments of di Lord una God, wey I command una today,
and di curse, if una no listen to di commandments of di Lord una God, but turn aside out of di way wey I command una today, to go after other gods wey una no know.
E go come be say, when di Lord your God don bring you into di land wia you go in to possess am, say you go set di blessing on Mount Gerizim, and di curse on Mount Ebal.
Dem no dey beyond di Jordan, behind di way of di going down of di sun, for di land of di Canaanites, wey dwell for di Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside di oaks of Moreh?
Because una dey to pass over di Jordan to go in to possess di land wey di Lord una God dey give una, and una go possess am, and dwell inside am.
Una go observe to do all di statutes and di ordinances wey I set before una today.”
“Dem na di statutes and di ordinances wey una go observe to do for di land wey di Lord, di God of your papa dem, don give you to possess am, all di days wey una live upon di earth.
Una go surely destroy all di places wia di nations wey una go dispossess serve dem gods, upon di high mountains, and upon di hills, and under every green tree.
Una go break down dem altars, and dash in pieces dem pillars, and burn dem Asherim with fire. Una go cut down di engraved images of dem gods, and destroy dem name out of dat place.
Una no go do so to di Lord una God.
But di place wey di Lord una God go choose out of all una tribes, to put im name dere, even im dwelling place, na dere una go seek, and dere you go come.
Dere una go bring una burnt offerings, and una sacrifices, and una tithes, and di heave offering of una hand, and una vows, and una free will offerings, and di firstborn of una herd and of una flock.
Dere una go eat before di Lord una God, and una go rejoice for all wey una put una hand to, una and una households, wherein di Lord your God don bless you.
Una no go do after all di things wey we dey do here today, every man wetin dey right for im own eyes,
because una never come to di rest and to di inheritance, wey di Lord your God dey give you.
But when una go over di Jordan, and dwell for di land wey di Lord una God cause una to inherit, and e give una rest from all una enemies round about, so that una dwell for safety,

di place wey di Lord una God go choose, to cause im name to dwell dere, dere una go bring all wey I command una: una burnt offerings, and una sacrifices, una tithes, and di heave offering of una hand, and all una choice vows wey una vow to di Lord.

Una go rejoice before di Lord una God, una, and una pikin man dem, and una pikin woman dem, and una male servants, and una female servants, and di Levite wey dey inside una gates, forasmuch as e no get portion nor inheritance with una.
Take heed to yourself say you no offer your burnt offerings for every place wey you see,
but for di place wey di Lord go choose, for one of your tribes, dere you go offer your burnt offerings, and dere you go do all wey I command you.

Notwithstanding you fit kill and eat flesh within all your gates, after all di desire of your soul, according to di blessing of di Lord your God wey e don give you. Di unclean and di clean fit eat of am, as of di gazelle, and as of di hart.
Only you no go eat di blood. You go pour am out on di earth as water.

You no fit eat within your gates di tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or di firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows wey you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor di heave offering of your hand,

but you go eat dem before di Lord your God for di place wey di Lord your God go choose, you, and your pikin man, and your pikin woman, and your male servant, and your female servant, and di Levite wey dey inside your gates. You go rejoice before di Lord your God for all wey you put your hands to.
Take heed to yourself say you no forsake di Levite as long as you live for your land.
When di Lord your God don enlarge your border, as e don promise you, and you talk, ‘I go eat flesh,’ because your soul desire to eat flesh, you fit eat flesh, after all di desire of your soul.

If di place wey di Lord your God go choose to put im name dere dey too far from you, you go kill of your herd and of your flock, wey di Lord don give you, as I don command you, and you go eat within your gates, after all di desire of your soul.
Even as di gazelle and di hart dey eaten, so you go eat dem. Di unclean and di clean go eat of dem alike.
Only be sure say you no eat di blood, because di blood na di life. You no go eat di life with di flesh.
You no go eat am. You go pour am out on di earth as water.
You no go eat am, so that e go go well with you, and with your pikin dem after you, when you do wetin dey right for di sight of di Lord.
Only your holy things wey you get, and your vows, you go take, and go to di place wey di Lord go choose.
You go offer your burnt offerings, di flesh and di blood, on di altar of di Lord your God. Di blood of your sacrifices go dey poured out on di altar of di Lord your God, and you go eat di flesh.
Observe and hear all dis words wey I command you, so that e go go well with you, and with your pikin dem after you forever, when you do wetin dey good and right for di sight of di Lord your God.
When di Lord your God go cut off di nations from before you, wia you go in to dispossess dem, and you dispossess dem, and dwell for dem land,
take heed to yourself say you no dey snared to follow dem, after dem dey destroyed from before you, and say you no enquire after dem gods, talk, ‘How dem nations serve dem gods? I go do di same.’
You no go do so to di Lord your God, because every abomination to di Lord, wey e hate, dem don do to dem gods. Even dem pikin man dem and dem pikin woman dem dem burn for fire to dem gods.
Whatever thing I command una, observe to do am. You no go add to am, nor take away from am.”
“If dere rise among una one prophet, or one dreamer of dreams, and e give una one sign or one wonder,
and di sign or di wonder come to pass, wey e speak to una, talk, ‘Make we go after other gods,’ wey una no know, ‘and make we serve dem,’
you no go listen to di words of dat prophet, or to dat dreamer of dreams, because di Lord una God dey test una, to know whether una love di Lord una God with all una heart and with all una soul.
Una go waka after di Lord una God, and fear am, and keep im commandments, and obey im voice, and una go serve am, and hold fast to am.

Dat prophet, or dat dreamer of dreams, go dey put to death, because e don speak rebellion against di Lord una God, wey bring una out of di land of Egypt, and redeem you out of di house of bondage, to draw you aside out of di way wey di Lord your God command you to waka in. So you go put away di evil from among una.

If your brother, di pikin of your mama, or your pikin man, or your pikin woman, or di wife of your bosom, or your friend, wey be as your own soul, entice you secretly, talk, ‘Make we go and serve other gods,’ wey you no know, you, nor your papa dem,
of di gods of di peoples wey dey round you, near to you, or far off from you, from di one end of di earth even to di other end of di earth,
you no go consent to am, nor listen to am. Neither go your eye pity am, neither go you spare, neither go you conceal am,
but you go surely kill am. Your hand go be first on am to put am to death, and after dat di hand of all di people.
You go stone am to death with stones, because e don seek to draw you away from di Lord your God, wey bring you out of di land of Egypt, out of di house of bondage.
All Israel go hear, and fear, and go do no more any such wickedness as dis among una.
If you hear say for one of your cities, wey di Lord your God dey give you to dwell inside, talk,
‘Certain wicked men don go out from among una, and don draw away di inhabitants of dem city, say make dem go and serve other gods wey una no know,’
you go enquire, and make search, and ask diligently. If e dey true, and di thing dey certain, say dis abomination dey done among una,
you go surely strike di inhabitants of dat city with di edge of di sword, destroying am utterly, and all wey dey inside am, and di livestock of am, with di edge of di sword.

You go gather all di plunder of am into di middle of di open square of am, and go burn with fire di city, and all di plunder of am, every bit, to di Lord your God. E go be one heap forever. E no go dey built again.

Nothing of di devoted thing go cling to your hand, so that di Lord go turn from di fierceness of im anger, and show you mercy, and have compassion on you, and multiply you, as e don swear to your papa dem,
when you listen to di voice of di Lord your God, to keep all im commandments wey I command you today, to do wetin dey right for di eyes of di Lord your God.”
“Una na di pikin dem of di Lord una God. Una no go cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between una eyes for di dead.
Because you na one holy people to di Lord your God, and di Lord don choose you to be one people for im own possession, above all peoples wey dey upon di surface of di earth.
You no go eat any abominable thing.
Dem na di animals wey una fit eat: di ox, di sheep, di goat,
di hart, di gazelle, di roebuck, di wild goat, di ibex, di antelope, and di mountain sheep.
Every animal wey divide di hoof, and cloven footed, and chew di cud, among di animals, una fit eat am.

Nevertheless una no go eat of dem wey chew di cud only, or of dem wey divide di cloven hoof only. Di camel, and di hare, and di rock hyrax, because dem chew di cud but no divide di hoof, dem dey unclean to una.
Di pig, because e divide di hoof but e no chew di cud, e dey unclean to una. Una no go eat of dem flesh, and una no go touch dem carcasses.
Dem na wetin una fit eat of all wey dey di waters: all wey get fins and scales una fit eat,
and whatever no get fins and scales una no go eat. E dey unclean to una.
Of all clean birds una fit eat.
But dem na di ones wey una no go eat: di eagle, di vulture, di black vulture,
di red kite, di falcon, any kind of kite,
any kind of raven,
di ostrich, di owl, di seagull, any kind of hawk,
di little owl, di great owl, di white owl,
di pelican, di carrion vulture, di cormorant,
di stork, any kind of heron, di hoopoe, and di bat.
All winged creeping things dey unclean to una. Dem no go dey eaten.
Of all clean birds una fit eat.

Una no go eat of anything wey die of itself. Una fit give am to di stranger wey dey inside una gates, so that e go eat am, or una fit sell am to one foreigner, because you na one holy people to di Lord your God. You no go boil one young goat for im mama milk.
You go surely tithe all di increase of your seed, wey di field produce year by year.

You go eat before di Lord your God, for di place wey e go choose to cause im name to dwell dere, di tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and di firstborn of your herd and of your flock, so that you go learn to fear di Lord your God always.
If di way dey too long for you, so that you no fit carry am, because di place dey too far from you, wey di Lord your God go choose to set im name dere, when di Lord your God bless you,
you go turn am into money, and bind up di money for your hand, and go to di place wey di Lord your God go choose.

You go spend di money for whatever your soul desire: for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul ask of you. You go eat dere before di Lord your God, and you go rejoice, you and your household.
You no go forsake di Levite wey dey inside your gates, because e no get portion nor inheritance with you.
At di end of every three years you go bring out all di tithe of your increase for dat same year, and go lay am up inside your gates.

Di Levite, because e no get portion nor inheritance with you, and di stranger, and di orphan, and di widow, wey dey inside your gates, go come, and go eat and dey full, so that di Lord your God go bless you for all di work of your hand wey you do.”
“At di end of every seven years you go make one release.
Dis na di way of di release: every creditor go release wetin e don lend to im neighbour. E no go exact am of im neighbour, or im brother, because dem don proclaim di Lord release.
Of one foreigner you fit exact am, but wetin dey yours with your brother, your hand go release.
However dere go be no poor among una, because di Lord go surely bless you for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance to possess am,
if only you diligently listen to di voice of di Lord your God, to observe to do all dis commandment wey I command you today.
Because di Lord your God go bless you, as e promise you. You go lend to many nations, but you no go borrow. You go rule over many nations, but dem no go rule over you.

If dere dey among una one poor man, one of your brothers, within any of your gates for your land wey di Lord your God dey give you, you no go harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother,
but you go surely open your hand to am, and go surely lend am sufficient for im need, wetin e lack.

Beware say dere no dey one wicked thought for your heart, talk, ‘Di seventh year, di year of release, dey near,’ and your eye dey evil against your poor brother, and you give am nothing. E go cry to di Lord against you, and e go be sin to you.
You go surely give am, and your heart no go dey grieved when you give am, because for dis thing di Lord your God go bless you for all your work, and for all wey you put your hand to.
Because di poor no go cease out of di land. Therefore I command you, talk, ‘You go surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, for your land.’
If your brother, one Hebrew man, or one Hebrew woman, dey sold to you, and serve you six years, for di seventh year you go let am go free from you.
When you let am go free from you, you no go let am go empty.
You go furnish am liberally out of your flock, and out of your threshing floor, and out of your winepress. As di Lord your God don bless you, you go give to am.
You go remember say you dey one servant for di land of Egypt, and di Lord your God redeem you. Na why I command you dis thing today.
E go be say, if e talk to you, ‘I no go go away from you,’ because e love you and your house, because e dey well with you,
you go take one awl, and thrust am through im ear to di door, and e go be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you go do likewise.
E no go seem hard to you, when you let am go free from you, because e don serve you six years, di double of di wages of one hired servant. Di Lord your God go bless you for all wey you do.
All di firstling males wey dey born of your herd and of your flock you go set apart to di Lord your God. You no go do any work with di firstling of your herd, nor shear di firstling of your flock.
You go eat am before di Lord your God year by year, for di place wey di Lord go choose, you and your household.
If e get any blemish, if e dey lame or blind, or get any bad blemish, you no go sacrifice am to di Lord your God.
You go eat am inside your gates. Di unclean and di clean go eat am alike, as di gazelle, and as di hart.
Only you no go eat im blood. You go pour am out on di ground as water.”
“Observe di month of Abib, and keep di Passover to di Lord your God, because for di month of Abib di Lord your God bring you out of Egypt by night.
You go sacrifice di Passover to di Lord your God, of di flock and di herd, for di place wey di Lord go choose to cause im name to dwell dere.

You no go eat any leavened bread with am. Seven days you go eat unleavened bread with am, even di bread of affliction, because you come out of di land of Egypt in haste, so that you go remember di day when you come out of di land of Egypt all di days of your life.
No leaven go dey seen with you for all your borders seven days. Neither go any of di flesh, wey you sacrifice di first day at evening, remain all night until morning.
You no fit sacrifice di Passover within any of your gates, wey di Lord your God dey give you,
but at di place wey di Lord your God go choose, to cause im name to dwell dere, na dere you go sacrifice di Passover at evening, at di going down of di sun, at di time wey you come out of Egypt.
You go roast and eat am for di place wey di Lord your God go choose. For di morning you go return to your tents.
Six days you go eat unleavened bread. For di seventh day go be one solemn assembly to di Lord your God. You go do no work.
You go count seven weeks for yourself. From di time wey you begin to put di sickle to di standing grain you go begin to count seven weeks.
You go keep di feast of weeks to di Lord your God with di tribute of one free will offering of your hand, wey you go give, according as di Lord your God bless you.

You go rejoice before di Lord your God, you, and your pikin man, and your pikin woman, and your male servant, and your female servant, and di Levite wey dey inside your gates, and di stranger, and di orphan, and di widow, wey dey among una, for di place wey di Lord your God go choose to cause im name to dwell dere.
You go remember say you dey one servant for Egypt. You go observe and do dem statutes.
You go keep di feast of booths seven days, after you don gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.

You go rejoice for your feast, you, and your pikin man, and your pikin woman, and your male servant, and your female servant, and di Levite, and di stranger, and di orphan, and di widow, wey dey inside your gates.

Seven days you go keep di feast to di Lord your God for di place wey di Lord go choose, because di Lord your God go bless you for all your increase, and for all di work of your hands, and you go dey altogether joyful.

Three times for one year all your males go appear before di Lord your God for di place wey e go choose: for di feast of unleavened bread, and for di feast of weeks, and for di feast of booths. Dem no go appear before di Lord empty.
Every man go give as e fit, according to di blessing of di Lord your God wey e don give you.
You go make judges and officers for all your gates, wey di Lord your God dey give you, according to your tribes. Dem go judge di people with righteous judgment.
You no go pervert justice. You no go show partiality, neither take one bribe, because one bribe blind di eyes of di wise, and subvert di cause of di righteous.
Righteousness, and only righteousness, you go follow, so that you go live, and inherit di land wey di Lord your God dey give you.
You no go plant for yourself one Asherah of any kind of tree beside di altar of di Lord your God, wey you go make for yourself.
Neither go you set up for yourself any pillar, wey di Lord your God hate.”
“You no go sacrifice to di Lord your God one ox or one sheep wey get any blemish, or any defect, because dat na abomination to di Lord your God.
If dere dey found among una, within any of your gates wey di Lord your God dey give you, man or woman wey do wetin dey evil for di sight of di Lord your God, in transgressing im covenant,
and don go and serve other gods, and worship dem, or di sun, or di moon, or any of di army of heaven, wey I no command,
and e dey told you, and you don hear am, you go enquire diligently. If e dey true, and di thing dey certain, say dis abomination dey done for Israel,
you go bring out dat man or dat woman, wey don do dis evil thing, to your gates, even di man or di woman, and you go stone dem to death with stones.
At di mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, di one wey dey worthy of death go dey put to death. At di mouth of one witness e no go dey put to death.
Di hand of di witnesses go be first on am to put am to death, and afterward di hand of all di people. So you go put away di evil from among una.

If one matter dey too hard for you for judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, you go arise and go up to di place wey di Lord your God go choose.
You go come to di Levitical priests, and to di judge wey dey for dem days. You go enquire, and dem go declare to you di sentence of judgment.
You go do according to di tenor of di sentence wey dem go declare to you from dat place wey di Lord go choose. You go observe to do according to all wey dem teach you.

According to di tenor of di law wey dem go teach you, and according to di judgment wey dem go tell you, you go do. You no go turn aside from di sentence wey dem go declare to you, to di right hand, nor to di left.
Di man wey go act presumptuously, in not listening to di priest wey stand to minister dere before di Lord your God, or to di judge, dat man go die. You go put away di evil from Israel.
All di people go hear, and fear, and go do no more presumptuously.
When you don come to di land wey di Lord your God dey give you, and don possess am, and dwell inside am, and go talk, ‘I go set one king over me, like all di nations wey dey round me,’
you go surely set am as king over you, whom di Lord your God go choose. One from among your brothers you go set as king over you. You no fit set one foreigner over you, wey no be your brother.
Only e no go multiply horses to imself, nor cause di people to return to Egypt, to multiply horses, because di Lord don talk to una, ‘Una no go return dat way again.’
Neither go e multiply wives to imself, so that im heart no go turn away. Neither go e greatly multiply to imself silver and gold.
E go come be say, when e sit on di throne of im kingdom, say e go write for imself one copy of dis law for one book, out of dat wey dey before di Levitical priests.
E go dey with am, and e go read inside am all di days of im life, so that e go learn to fear di Lord im God, to keep all di words of dis law and dis statutes, to do dem,

so that im heart no go dey lifted up above im brothers, and so that e no go turn aside from di commandment, to di right hand, or to di left, so that e go prolong im days for im kingdom, e and im pikin dem, for di midst of Israel.”
